posts.author: elonmusk
posts.text:
Elon Musk becomes deeply moved, and deadly serious, when Bret Baier asks him why he called Sen. Mark Kelly a "Traitor" for pushing to send more US aid and weapons to Ukraine.

Watch every second of his response.

"We should have empathy for the thousands of people dying everyday in the trenches. For no movement in the lines. For the past two years thousands of people have died every week for nothing."

"I take great offense at those who put the appearance of goodness over the reality of it. Those who virtue signal and say we can't give into Russia, but have no solution to stopping thousands of kids dying every day."

"I have contempt for such people and I want to make that clear. Because they're virtue signaling and their lack of a solution means that kids don't have a father. It means parents lost a son. For what? Nothing."

posts.text: Wow

quote.author: emd_worldwide
quote.name: Martin De Luca
quote.text:
Let’s make sure the entire world understands. In Brazil, judicial rulings in connection with federal elections are made by the court that has been in place for that very purpose, the Supreme Electoral Tribunal (TSE). 

@LulaOficial requested to the TSE that the polls be extended by two more hours in the entire country, citing “transportation problems.” Who controls the transport system? Lula’s government surely more so than a senator running for president. 

Instead of waiting for a TSE ruling. @LulaOficial immediately asked Brazilian Supreme Court (STF) justice @Cristianozaninm to order the polls remain open WITHOUT any TSE ruling. Within minutes (did Zanin even read the filing?), the polls were ordered to remain open by Zanin. 

The STF has 11 justices. What did Zanin do before becoming an STF justice? Oh yes, he was Lula’s criminal defense lawyer in his corruption cases. 

If this blatant rigging of the elections will be used to announce that Lula won, is Lula seriously expecting anyone in the international community to recognize that as a free and fair election? He knows nobody will. 

Has the desperation reached a point that today is the day the mask fully comes off and Lula becomes the next Nicolas Maduro? For the sake of Brazil, I pray that is not the case.

How come Elon Musk is the only one seriously talking about all these young people dying in the trenches for no reason and begging for this war to stop? Innocent young Ukrainians and Russian conscripts are getting blown apart by drones, losing their lives

And then you look at Europe. What do you only keep hearing from so many European leaders? More weapons, more ammunition, more military support. “We cannot let Russia win”

You almost never hear them seriously talking about how to bring peace and end this war for good

Why the hell aren't those same leaders putting that much energy into figuring out how to stop this meat grinder?

What are these leaders actually doing to stop young people from dying every single day? What are they doing to end this endless slaughter? Why aren't they putting the same urgency into finding a way to end this war instead of constantly talking about sending more weapons and how they should continue this war forever?

These are human beings. They have parents, families, loved ones, and entire lives ahead of them. And they're dying in trenches because of decisions made by people who will never have to experience what those young soldiers are going through

And that includes the poor Russian conscripts who have no choice but to fight. They're human beings too. Their lives matter too

How many more young people need to die before stopping this war becomes just as important as deciding who wins it?

Why does it take Elon Musk to keep reminding people about the human lives being destroyed by this war?

Seriously, where the hell is the urgency to stop all this killing? everyone who wants to continue this war is pure evil

quote.author: XFreeze
quote.name: X Freeze
quote.text:
Elon Musk warned about the Ukraine war years ago, and it's absolutely tragic how accurately he predicted the devastating cost of human lives from this conflict

Back in October 2022, Elon didn't just call for peace. He actually proposed a peace plan involving UN-supervised votes in occupied regions, recognizing Crimea as Russian, guaranteeing its water supply, and Ukraine remaining neutral

He warned that continuing this war would bring devastating death and destruction, with countless young Ukrainians and Russians losing their lives

And look at what's happened since then

More than 2 MILLION military casualties, entire cities destroyed, millions of people forced from their homes, and the war is still going on with no lasting peace

Elon faced enormous backlash for proposing a path toward peace, but the human cost he warned about has become an absolutely horrifying reality

And that's what makes this so tragic. These are human beings with parents, families, loved ones, and entire lives ahead of them, not disposable pieces on some geopolitical chessboard

How many more young people have to die in trenches before ending this endless slaughter becomes just as important as deciding who wins the war?

Elon saw the devastating human cost of a prolonged war coming years ago, and instead of taking his warning seriously, people attacked him for even putting a peace proposal on the table

Just imagine how many lives could have been saved if a lasting peace had been reached years earlier

How much more death and destruction will it take before ending this meat grinder becomes the priority??

New Starlink in flight Wi-Fi review:

"I was flying over the Sierra Nevada mountain range recently when I had a tech experience that left me enthralled. It also shows why I believe @elonmusk is the greatest technologist working today. Simply stated, I was blown away.

Instead of playing a downloaded movie, I logged in to Netflix and couldn’t believe the quality of the streaming. So, I did what any broadband speed freak would do. I grabbed my Ookla app and tested the download speeds.

It came back at a blazing 408 megabits a second. That’s roughly 30% faster than the median speeds for U.S. households, the vast majority of which have hardwired connections.

I bring up this example because I believe it speaks volumes about how Musk just keeps on transforming the world around us."

In fall 2027, Southwest Airlines expects to complete a fleetwide rollout of Starlink, becoming the first major airline to do so.
